changelog: - **“All or nothing” now counts two connections between the same pair together, and a Gate below a broken loop runs.** Two corrections to the engine, both for shapes a document can hold but few do. A Drain or End set to “pull all”, and a Source set to “push all”, tested each connection on its own: with two “5” connections off a Pool of 8, the Drain’s record said 5 + 5 had left while the Pool lost 8, and a Source with two “5” connections into a Pool with room for 8 pushed 5 + 3. They now ask the Pool once for both, and move nothing unless everything fits. Separately, a loop of Gates or Converters with no Pool in it is inactive, and so was every Gate further down from it, even with its own Pool to pull from: Gates A and B feeding each other, B also feeding C, left C doing nothing and marked as part of the loop. Only the nodes on the loop are inactive now; C pulls from its Pool, and in the Relations panel a probabilistic Gate below such a loop shows its chances again instead of “at run time”. None of the bundled examples changes. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 9).
